method: Browser pane. get_page_text on product pages returned only site header/popular-product text (product block not extracted). Ingredient text taken from each product page's Ingredients block (.ingredients-wrapper p) via in-page fetch of each product URL, parsed with DOMParser; spot-checked against the rendered DOM for advanced-repair-creme and advanced-cleansing.
site_limitation: No product page publishes a full INCI list. Each Ingredients block prints only key ingredients (its own disclaimer says 'Learn more about the key ingredients of this product'); sunscreen and oatmeal products print 'Active Ingredients' with percentages only. Grades in this audit are on the printed subset only.
